Osk.title.note: On-screen keyboard (over the machine's screen): the words in its bar, which moves it.

Osk.close.note: On-screen keyboard: tooltip and screen-reader name of the × button in its bar.

Osk.resize.message: Drag sideways to resize the keyboard.
Osk.resize.note: On-screen keyboard: tooltip of the ↔ handle in its bar, left of the close button.

Osk.toCompact.note: On-screen keyboard: tooltip and screen-reader name of the button in its bar (left of the resize handle) that shows the compact layout for a phone's width, its keys on pages chosen by tabs, instead of the full 104 keys.

Osk.toFull.note: On-screen keyboard: tooltip and screen-reader name of the button in its bar (left of the resize handle) that shows the full 104-key keyboard instead of the compact layout's pages.

Osk.page.main.note: On-screen keyboard, compact layout: the words of a tab in its bar choosing a page of keys: the first tab, the letters, the digits and the keys around them; lowercase as a phone keyboard's tab. Very short (a few characters).

Osk.pageTitle.main.note: On-screen keyboard, compact layout: tooltip of the tab "abc" in its bar, saying which keys its page has.

Osk.page.symbols.note: On-screen keyboard, compact layout: the words of a tab in its bar choosing a page of keys: the second tab, the punctuation keys, Caps Lock, the right-hand Shift, Ctrl, Alt, Super, Menu and the arrows; symbols as a phone keyboard's tab. Very short (a few characters).

Osk.pageTitle.symbols.message: Symbols, the right-hand modifiers and the arrows
Osk.pageTitle.symbols.note: On-screen keyboard, compact layout: tooltip of the tab "#+=" in its bar, saying which keys its page has.

Osk.page.fn.note: On-screen keyboard, compact layout: the words of a tab in its bar choosing a page of keys: the third tab, F1–F12, Print Screen, Scroll Lock, Pause, Insert, Home, Page Up and Down, Delete, End and the arrows. Very short (a few characters).

Osk.pageTitle.fn.note: On-screen keyboard, compact layout: tooltip of the tab "Fn" in its bar, saying which keys its page has.

Osk.page.keypad.note: On-screen keyboard, compact layout: the words of a tab in its bar choosing a page of keys: the fourth tab, the numeric keypad with Num Lock. Very short (a few characters).

Osk.pageTitle.keypad.note: On-screen keyboard, compact layout: tooltip of the tab "Num" in its bar, saying which keys its page has.

Osk.key.Escape.note: On-screen keyboard: the Escape key's label, as a US keyboard labels it.

Osk.key.Tab.note: On-screen keyboard: the Tab key's label.

Osk.key.CapsLock.note: On-screen keyboard: the Caps Lock key's label.

Osk.key.Shift.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of both Shift keys.

Osk.key.Control.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of both Control keys.

Osk.key.Meta.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of both Windows (Super, Meta) keys, beside Ctrl and Alt.

Osk.key.Alt.note: On-screen keyboard: the left Alt key's label.

Osk.key.AltGr.note: On-screen keyboard: the right Alt key's label (AltGr on layouts that use it for a third character).

Osk.key.ContextMenu.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of the context menu key, between the right Super and Ctrl keys.

Osk.key.Backspace.note: On-screen keyboard: the Backspace key's label.

Osk.key.BackspaceShort.note: On-screen keyboard: the Backspace key's label where the key is only one key wide (a Japanese keyboard's, beside the yen key): a symbol, or a very short word.

Osk.key.HankakuZenkaku.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of a Japanese keyboard's Hankaku/Zenkaku key (half-width/full-width input), left of 1, as the key is printed. Keep it as is unless the language's Japanese keyboards print it otherwise.

Osk.key.Enter.note: On-screen keyboard: the label of the Enter key and the keypad's Enter key.

Osk.key.PrintScreen.note: On-screen keyboard: the Print Screen key's label, right of F12.

Osk.key.ScrollLock.note: On-screen keyboard: the Scroll Lock key's label.

Osk.key.Pause.note: On-screen keyboard: the Pause (Break) key's label.

Osk.key.Insert.note: On-screen keyboard: the Insert key's label.

Osk.key.Home.note: On-screen keyboard: the Home key's label.

Osk.key.PageUp.note: On-screen keyboard: the Page Up key's label.

Osk.key.Delete.note: On-screen keyboard: the Delete key's label.

Osk.key.End.note: On-screen keyboard: the End key's label.

Osk.key.PageDown.note: On-screen keyboard: the Page Down key's label.

Osk.key.NumLock.note: On-screen keyboard: the Num Lock key's label, at the top left of the numeric keypad.

Osk.key.ArrowUp.note: On-screen keyboard: the Up arrow key's label (a symbol).

Osk.key.ArrowDown.note: On-screen keyboard: the Down arrow key's label (a symbol).

Osk.key.ArrowLeft.note: On-screen keyboard: the Left arrow key's label (a symbol).

Osk.key.ArrowRight.note: On-screen keyboard: the Right arrow key's label (a symbol).
